rules.accepted_credit_types: AAVSB RACE-approved courses and statutorily approved providers (B&P Code §4846.5); classroom, conferences, seminars, interactive online and self-study
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for initial licensees (licensed in California for less than two years).
rules.alternatives: Petition for waiver under specific criteria; inactive license needs no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep proof of CE for at least 4 years.
rules.notes: Max 6 h self-study/non-interactive online; online unlimited but at least 30 h must be interactive. Max 24 h practice management. 1 h on judicious use of medically important antimicrobial drugs every 4 years (no matching topic code). No extensions.
rules.legal_basis: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §4846.5; §4858.1(e); 16 CCR Div. 20, Art. 9
